assumption_text: Official metrics capture the most important early changes
monitoring_signal: Affected communities report change before official data registers it.

assumption_text: AI governance can respond after public-service adoption scales
monitoring_signal: Deployment creates lock-in before accountability rules are settled.

assumption_text: Climate adaptation signals are isolated rather than connected

assumption_text: Weak signal reports will influence strategy without formal decision linkage
